audit.whatIsWrong: The page grades itself three different ways at once: diff says HARD, tone is the green favoured colour, diffRating says 4/10 and breakdown.difficulty says 'Favoured matchup' — all on a matchup the packet scores at 47.28% over 184 games.
audit.why: A sub-50% lane cannot be a 4/10 favoured matchup, and HARD cannot share a page with a green tone and a Favoured label. The prose itself concedes levels 4-5 to Garen, which is the honest read.
audit.corrected: Settled on EVEN with an even tone, difficulty 6/10 and carry threat 6/10, and the difficulty line and final rating updated to match. The seven-stage chart was left untouched so no mirror conflict is introduced.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike and cooldown line names Courage as the clock but never gives a number, and Decisive Strike's silence is described without its cooldown.
audit.why: Courage is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s, Decisive Strike a flat 8s, Judgment 9/8.25/7.5/6.75/6s, Demacian Justice 120/100/80s. Against your Miasma at 24s, the 22s Courage is what actually decides whether a commit lands full damage.
audit.corrected: 22s, 8s, 9s and your own 24s written into the cooldown block, the 4-5 spike and the wants list.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions never appear anywhere. Nothing says Decisive Strike breaks slows, and nothing says Courage's tenacity shortens Petrifying Gaze — yet the page tells you to rely on Miasma's slow and on the R stun.
audit.why: Riot's Decisive Strike text: 'Garen gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him.' That undoes Miasma's slow and any Rylai's slow outright. Riot's Courage text gives 'a shield and tenacity for a brief moment', and tenacity cuts stun duration, so a Courage held for your ult clips Petrifying Gaze. Separately Perseverance only regenerates 'if Garen has not recently been struck by damage or enemy abilities' — your poison ticks deny it entirely, which is a free tax the page never claims.
audit.corrected: Slow-break, tenacity-on-your-stun and the Perseverance denial written into the spikes, wants, key-interactions and trigger lines. Miasma is now sold for its grounding and poison rather than its slow.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are yours if you stack poison cleanly. Concede level 1 — you have one ability and no chain yet — so just farm from the edge of Noxious Blast (Q) and stay out of his auto range so he can't get a free Decisive Strike trade. At 2 and 3 you come online: tag him with Q, then Twin Fang (E) refunds off the poison and lets you spam it, out-DPSing his spin-and-leave. Drop Miasma (W) where he wants to walk so it grounds and slows his run-in. The one thing to respect is his Q silence — never throw Twin Fang the instant he steps up, or Decisive Strike cancels your cast and flips the trade.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are yours if you stack poison cleanly. Concede level 1 — you have one ability and no chain yet — so farm from the edge of Noxious Blast (Q) and stay out of auto range so he cannot get a free Decisive Strike trade. At 2 and 3 you come online: tag him with Q, then Twin Fang (E) refunds off the poison and lets you spam it, out-DPSing his spin-and-leave. Every poison tick also counts as being struck, so Perseverance stops regenerating — the chip stays on him. Drop Miasma (W) where he wants to walk for the grounding, not the slow. Respect his 8s Q silence: never throw Twin Fang the instant he steps up.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are his window, and the 47% win rate reflects it: ranked Decisive Strike silences your cast, Courage gives him tenacity plus damage reduction, and you have no defensive steroid but your passive move speed. Don't stand and trade — kite with your speed buff off Q, give ground, and chip from max range so his spin never connects clean. At 6 you reclaim the all-in: hold Petrifying Gaze (R) for the instant he commits face-on, stun him out of the spin, and your refunding Twin Fang shreds him before he can disengage. Never burn R early or fire it sideways — it only stuns enemies facing you.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are his window, and the 47% win rate reflects it: Decisive Strike silences your cast every 8s and breaks every slow on him, Courage gives tenacity plus damage reduction, and you have no defensive steroid but your passive move speed. Don't stand and trade — kite with your speed buff off Q and chip from max range so his spin never connects clean. At 6 you reclaim the all-in, but spend Petrifying Gaze while Courage is on its 22s: tenacity cuts your stun short otherwise. Fire it as he commits face-on — it only stuns enemies facing you — then Twin Fang shreds him.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze (R) answers his all-in — when he sprints at you face-on, stun him out of the spin and your refunding Twin Fang melts him before he can disengage.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze (R) answers his all-in — stun him face-on out of the spin, but spend it while Courage is on its 22s, because its tenacity cuts your stun short.
